title: Digital Booking Benefit Terms: App and Website Valet Bonus (Guest Folios)
content:
Stays booked on the Ashbury mobile app or the brand website receive a valet bonus per night on the Ashbury Rewards valet savings posted to Guest Folios.

**Term.** Booking-channel valet bonus: a reservation booked on the mobile app adds the app valet bonus of $1.00 per night, one booked on the brand website adds the website valet bonus of $0.50 per night, and one booked through any other channel adds nothing. The bonus is added to the nightly valet saving, and that per-night figure is then taken for each valet line of the stay.

The booking channel is the channel shown on the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio.

| Booking channel on the Room Reservations record | Valet bonus per night |
|---|---|
| Mobile app | $1.00 |
| Brand website | $0.50 |
| Call centre, the hotel directly, online travel agency, travel agency or group rooming list | None |

## Points of judgement

- **Booked through the call centre.** Not the mobile app or the brand website: no channel bonus.
- **Booked on the app, five valet lines.** $1.00 for each of the five valet lines, $5.00 over the stay.
- **Booked on the website, three valet lines.** $0.50 for each, $1.50 over the stay.
